deadline_capability_matrix.name: call_admission_deadline
deadline_capability_matrix.guarantee: No new call is admitted unless its reserved wait and finalization allowance fit the remaining item and window budget.

deadline_capability_matrix.name: call_wait_deadline
deadline_capability_matrix.guarantee: A local worker is observed until the configured wait deadline; a blocked public client is not force-terminated by the inline solve seam.
deadline_capability_matrix.verification: Blocking-stub runner test; timeout remains recorded if the worker is still active.

deadline_capability_matrix.name: local_work_unit_termination
deadline_capability_matrix.guarantee: A daemon worker can be bounded and accounted for, but an arbitrary synchronous client cannot be killed safely in-process.
deadline_capability_matrix.verification: Active-worker count, timeout event, and late completion event.

deadline_capability_matrix.name: remote_cancellation
deadline_capability_matrix.guarantee: The public chat contract exposes no cancellation handle; stopping local waiting does not claim remote cancellation.
deadline_capability_matrix.verification: No cancellation API is assumed; reports use remote_cancellation=unknown.

deadline_capability_matrix.name: solve_return_deadline
deadline_capability_matrix.guarantee: The host can refuse later work, but cannot force a synchronous injected client to return before it returns.
deadline_capability_matrix.verification: Platform runner timeout and local post-return timing only.

deadline_capability_matrix.name: window_stop
deadline_capability_matrix.guarantee: The runner stops dispatching new tasks at the window deadline or on an unresolved active call; pending tasks are marked skipped.
deadline_capability_matrix.verification: Planned/dispatched/skipped counts and stop_reason in report.
